note: Initialised 2026-09-21 (PRD-0038 AC-5.4) with `bun run build && bun scripts/ci-gates.mjs typecheck-ratchet --update`, measured with build artifacts present because that is the order CI runs in. Ratchet, not a target: lower this number by fixing test-surface type errors and re-record in the same commit — the gate fails on both regression and unexplained slack. Reconciling with #306 (1379, filed 2026-08-14): 1805 = 1595 in the two areas #306 names (packages/*/test 1245 + apps/cli/test 350, up 216 since it was filed, mostly PRD-0034/0035/0038 test additions) + 210 outside the scope #306 counted (apps/web/client/test 184, apps/web/server/src tests 24, packages/storage/test 2 — the apps/web includes landed in 3bed20c/d2f7c0d, the same week, and were never in #306's stated tally). Neither number is wrong; they count different include sets at different times. This file records what the gate actually measures today.
